campaign: K3 compact M_e=245 exact schedule discriminator
question: On one empirical-scale expert bucket, does exact width-eight identical-mask grouping or a differing-mask union remove enough rowwise compact work to earn live layer-major integration?

fixture.requested_masks: eight deterministic masks with 1..8 selected natural slabs, repeated in fixed order
fixture.weight_generation: deterministic frozen seeds in the sentinel source
fixture.timing_scope: candidate wall includes weight/input/map uploads, graph construction, graph execution, and output readback; deterministic fixture/group construction is excluded

arms_in_fixed_order: rowwise teachers embedded in every case
primary_metrics: candidate speedup versus its rowwise teacher

correctness_gate.outputs: byte-identical for every real row versus current one-row compact teacher
correctness_gate.dispatch: MMVQ launches greater than zero and MMQ launches equal zero
correctness_gate.payload: candidate authoritative H2D equals exactly one payload per union or complete-mask group

performance_gate.winner: Among same-workload candidates that clear 1.6x, choose lower candidate_ns
performance_gate.simplicity_tiebreak: If grouped and union candidate_ns are within 5%, choose identical-mask grouping
performance_gate.no_go: If neither same-workload candidate clears 1.6x, neither earns live integration

abort_conditions: wrong physical device or platform profile
any correctness, dispatch, or accounting failure

interpretation_boundary: This is a model-free expert compute/H2D discriminator. It cannot by itself establish live prefill throughput, storage scheduling, recurrent-state parity, or full-logit parity.
